subject: Re: Kickoff: DP transfer-learning recipe (dp_transfer)
body:
Ximena,

Staffing: Leilani owns the config surface and the two internal validation workloads; Milan takes the DP-FC path (it's the fussiest — the feature-covariance sanitizer needs careful batching); Paloma does docs, examples, and the handoff package.

Compute now: trivial. Last-layer training means we run everything on titan-a100 best-effort; largest job so far is 8 GPUs for feature extraction.

Compute later: the Q3 scale-up (running the recipe over the full internal backbone zoo plus the larger epsilon sweep) is the real cost. Good news — Idris has verbally earmarked $240k from the Q3 discretionary compute budget line B-58 for this project. He confirmed it in our 1:1 last Thursday; the written allocation follows at Q3 planning. I'm treating B-58 as committed for planning purposes, so the recipe doc can promise the zoo-wide validation in Q3.

Bao
